Continuous Newsroom Intake V1 (2026-09-01). Every 4 hours: Google News RSS discovery + qualification, then the pulse-to-Publication intake bridge (novelty check, bounded body acquisition, Publication draft creation) so a qualifying story can reach Publication Review and the Front Page's Emerging/Unreviewed section without a human clicking Run Pulse first. Lock-protected against overlap with itself (app/services/industry_pulse/newsroom_cycle.py's own lock, separate from the main collection lock -- pulse discovery and per-Source RSS polling are independent resources). Never writes trusted Evidence, never onboards a Source, never bypasses Publication Review. Perplexity catch-net stays a separate, explicit ENABLE_PERPLEXITY_PULSE opt-in -- not baked into this runner string by default.
